# Image fixtures

The additional photographic fixtures are unmodified files from scikit-image,
pinned to v0.25.2:

- astronaut.png: NASA portrait of Eileen Collins; no known copyright restrictions,
  released into the public domain.
- chelsea.png: Stefan van der Walt; CC0, no copyright restrictions.
- coffee.png: Rachel Michetti, courtesy of Pikolo Espresso Bar; CC0, no copyright restrictions.
- camera.png: Lav Varshney; CC0, no copyright restrictions.

Sources: https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/tree/v0.25.2/skimage/data
and https://scikit-image.org/docs/0.25.x/api/skimage.data.html

dog.jpg and mountain.jpg are the existing project benchmark fixtures.
Synthetic quality fixtures are drawn by tests/benchmark/quality-cases.js.
The user's personal source artwork is used only in ignored local diagnostics.
